what: Several plates (photos) line up horizontally, and while scrolling one screen height per cell they come to the center in turn from the first plate to the last, toward the screen edges they bend back by (x/1.8)² like a round wall (WebGL). If scrolling is fast the plates bend sideways, and when scrolled up that plate spreads to grayscale from the center and recedes while a following circle appears
ease: none (scroll) · quart.out (following circle) · exponential decay (monochrome 4 · retreat 10 · bend 16 · circle 9)

options.z: Camera distance, default 7.5 — board height is always half the visible height
options.gap: Gap between panels (× panel width), default 0.25
options.bow: Edge bend depth (× visible height), default 0.5 — 1/4 below 960px
options.skew: Scroll speed bend (px per frame × panel width), default 0.004 — up to ±5% of panel width
options.depth: Distance the raised panel recedes (times panel height), default 0.18
options.min: Panel size random lower bound (in 0.05 steps up to 1), default 0.8 — fixed by the panel’s data-scale
options.narrow: Phone width (px), default 960 — below it, hover is turned off and bend is reduced
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One panel. Inside Fills it to cover, and if absent uses the data-label placeholder. With data-href, press to open in a new tab
options.[data-fx-part=pointer]: (Optional) Circle following the cursor over the panel
options.Event fx:bow-gallery: detail.index (the board currently shown — an uploaded board takes priority) · current · hovered — when swapping the title, label and number

Section height is set by the part as number of panels × 100svh. Fixed UI such as a title is layered on by the consumer with sticky, and the part is swapped to fx:bow-gallery. three is loaded as window.THREE by placing this folder’s three-global.js before library/_vendor/three@0.174.0/build/three.cjs

from.where: index.js Service gallery (original home_service — r3f instancedMesh · uBowDepth · uScrollSkew · uTileHoverMix)

note: The canvas is pinned to the screen and draws only while the section is on screen. The original picks the panel size randomly on each open, so the travel distance differs by 1~2% each time. Scroll speed is measured with ScrollTrigger speed (px/s ÷ 60) instead of Lenis.
